data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: hermes-webui
edge_embedded.summary: Hermes WebUI 是为 Hermes Agent 打造的浏览器界面，让你在任何设备上都能轻松使用先进的 AI 智能体。它通过简洁、响应式的 Web 界面封装了 Hermes 智能体框架，支持桌面和手机。其核心技术亮点是使用 WebSocket 实现实时交互，让智能体的流式响应无缝呈现。你可以本地部署或在服务器上运行，体验自主任务执行、工具调用和多步推理。尝试用它来构建自己的 AI 助手或自动化工作流，无需从头编写 UI 代码。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Hermes WebUI is a browser-based interface for Hermes Agent, making advanced AI agent capabilities accessible from any device. It wraps the Hermes agent framework in a clean, responsive web UI that works on desktop and mobile. The key insight is its use of WebSockets for real-time agent interaction, enabling seamless streaming responses. You can deploy it locally or on a server to experiment with autonomous task execution, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. Try it to build your own AI assistant or automate workflows without coding a UI from scratch.

ui_devex.name: markitdown
ui_devex.summary: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。
ui_devex.summary_en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.

ui_devex.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
ui_devex.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo是一款基于Python的开源AI短视频自动生成工具。它通过集成大语言模型生成脚本、文本转语音合成旁白，并利用moviepy库处理视觉素材，构建了从主题输入到视频一键输出的高效流程。该工具采用模块化设计，支持灵活替换AI模型与调整视觉模板，便于用户快速制作营销、教育或社交类短片，同时可通过参数配置探索个性化风格，为内容创作提供了便捷的实验平台。
ui_devex.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an open-source Python tool that automates short video creation using AI large language models, addressing the time-intensive process of manual video production. It works by integrating multiple AI components—LLMs for script generation, text-to-speech for voiceovers, and moviepy for visual assembly—into a streamlined pipeline that requires minimal user input. Developers can use it to quickly prototype marketing content, educational explainers, or social media clips by simply providing a topic, then customize the workflow by swapping AI models or adjusting visual templates for specific needs.

ui_devex.name: developer-portfolios
ui_devex.summary: developer-portfolios 是一个精选的开发者个人作品集网站列表，旨在为你构建自己的作品集提供灵感。它汇集了真实开发者的网站，展示了多样化的设计、布局和内容策略。该仓库以简单的列表形式呈现，方便浏览和学习。你可以通过浏览列表收集创意，分析常见模式，或直接链接到作品集作为参考。将其作为起点，设计一个能体现你独特技能和个性的作品集。
ui_devex.summary_en: developer-portfolios is a curated collection of real developer portfolio websites, serving as inspiration for building your own. It showcases diverse designs, layouts, and content strategies from actual developers. The repository is a simple list, making it easy to browse and learn from peers. You can explore the list to gather ideas, analyze common patterns, or directly link to portfolios for reference. Use it as a starting point to design a portfolio that reflects your unique skills and personality.

ui_devex.name: docs
ui_devex.summary: 这是GitHub官方文档的开源仓库，任何人都可以参与改进。项目采用Markdown编写，配合自定义静态站点生成器，文章、教程和API参考结构清晰。开发者可以克隆仓库，在本地编辑文档，然后提交拉取请求来帮助保持GitHub文档的准确性和时效性。通过这个项目，你可以学习如何构建大型技术文档站点，并直接为全球开发者使用的资源做贡献。
ui_devex.summary_en: This is the open-source repository behind GitHub's official documentation, making it easy for anyone to contribute fixes or improvements. It uses Markdown and a custom static site generator, with a clear structure for articles, tutorials, and API references. ui_devex.name: pi-subagents
ui_devex.summary: pi-subagents 是 Pi 框架的扩展，用于实现异步子代理任务委派，解决复杂多步骤工作流的管理难题。其核心技术亮点是支持截断、工件和会话共享，使子代理能高效传递中间结果并保持上下文连贯。你可以用它构建模块化 AI 系统：主代理将数据检索、代码生成等子任务分派给专用子代理，从而提升系统的可扩展性和可维护性。
ui_devex.summary_en: pi-subagents extends the Pi framework to enable asynchronous delegation of tasks to sub-agents, solving the problem of managing complex, multi-step workflows. Its key technical insight is supporting truncation, artifacts, and session sharing, allowing sub-agents to pass intermediate results and maintain context efficiently. You can use it to build modular AI systems where a primary agent orchestrates specialized sub-agents for subtasks like data retrieval or code generation, improving scalability and maintainability.

ui_devex.name: claude-code
ui_devex.summary: Claude Code 是一款基于终端的AI编程助手，它通过自然语言命令帮助开发者自动化日常任务并理解复杂代码库。其核心在于能够分析整个代码仓库的上下文，直接在开发环境中提供智能建议并执行命令。你可以用它生成样板代码、调试现有函数或管理Git工作流——只需用简单英语描述需求，它就能处理具体的实现细节，让编程工作更高效直观。
ui_devex.summary_en: Claude Code is a terminal-based AI coding assistant that helps developers automate routine tasks and understand complex codebases through natural language commands. It works by analyzing your entire code repository context to provide intelligent suggestions and execute commands directly in your development environment. You can use it to generate boilerplate code, debug existing functions, or manage Git workflows—simply type your request in plain English and let it handle the implementation details.

agents_workflows.name: markitdown
agents_workflows.summary: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.

agents_workflows.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
agents_workflows.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo是一款基于Python的开源AI短视频自动生成工具。它通过集成大语言模型生成脚本、文本转语音合成旁白，并利用moviepy库处理视觉素材，构建了从主题输入到视频一键输出的高效流程。该工具采用模块化设计，支持灵活替换AI模型与调整视觉模板，便于用户快速制作营销、教育或社交类短片，同时可通过参数配置探索个性化风格，为内容创作提供了便捷的实验平台。
agents_workflows.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an open-source Python tool that automates short video creation using AI large language models, addressing the time-intensive process of manual video production. It works by integrating multiple AI components—LLMs for script generation, text-to-speech for voiceovers, and moviepy for visual assembly—into a streamlined pipeline that requires minimal user input. Developers can use it to quickly prototype marketing content, educational explainers, or social media clips by simply providing a topic, then customize the workflow by swapping AI models or adjusting visual templates for specific needs.

agents_workflows.name: hermes-webui
agents_workflows.summary: Hermes WebUI 是为 Hermes Agent 打造的浏览器界面，让你在任何设备上都能轻松使用先进的 AI 智能体。它通过简洁、响应式的 Web 界面封装了 Hermes 智能体框架，支持桌面和手机。其核心技术亮点是使用 WebSocket 实现实时交互，让智能体的流式响应无缝呈现。你可以本地部署或在服务器上运行，体验自主任务执行、工具调用和多步推理。尝试用它来构建自己的 AI 助手或自动化工作流，无需从头编写 UI 代码。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Hermes WebUI is a browser-based interface for Hermes Agent, making advanced AI agent capabilities accessible from any device. It wraps the Hermes agent framework in a clean, responsive web UI that works on desktop and mobile. The key insight is its use of WebSockets for real-time agent interaction, enabling seamless streaming responses. You can deploy it locally or on a server to experiment with autonomous task execution, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. Try it to build your own AI assistant or automate workflows without coding a UI from scratch.

deployment_serving.name: hermes-webui
deployment_serving.summary: Hermes WebUI 是为 Hermes Agent 打造的浏览器界面，让你在任何设备上都能轻松使用先进的 AI 智能体。它通过简洁、响应式的 Web 界面封装了 Hermes 智能体框架，支持桌面和手机。其核心技术亮点是使用 WebSocket 实现实时交互，让智能体的流式响应无缝呈现。你可以本地部署或在服务器上运行，体验自主任务执行、工具调用和多步推理。尝试用它来构建自己的 AI 助手或自动化工作流，无需从头编写 UI 代码。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Hermes WebUI is a browser-based interface for Hermes Agent, making advanced AI agent capabilities accessible from any device. It wraps the Hermes agent framework in a clean, responsive web UI that works on desktop and mobile. The key insight is its use of WebSockets for real-time agent interaction, enabling seamless streaming responses. You can deploy it locally or on a server to experiment with autonomous task execution, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. Try it to build your own AI assistant or automate workflows without coding a UI from scratch.

framework_core.name: pi-subagents
framework_core.summary: pi-subagents 是 Pi 框架的扩展，用于实现异步子代理任务委派，解决复杂多步骤工作流的管理难题。其核心技术亮点是支持截断、工件和会话共享，使子代理能高效传递中间结果并保持上下文连贯。你可以用它构建模块化 AI 系统：主代理将数据检索、代码生成等子任务分派给专用子代理，从而提升系统的可扩展性和可维护性。
framework_core.summary_en: pi-subagents extends the Pi framework to enable asynchronous delegation of tasks to sub-agents, solving the problem of managing complex, multi-step workflows. Its key technical insight is supporting truncation, artifacts, and session sharing, allowing sub-agents to pass intermediate results and maintain context efficiently. You can use it to build modular AI systems where a primary agent orchestrates specialized sub-agents for subtasks like data retrieval or code generation, improving scalability and maintainability.
